headline: Confie Acquires TDECU Insurance Agency to Expand Credit Union Partnerships
summary: Confie has acquired the insurance operations of TDECU, integrating the agency into its InsureOne brand. The move aims to expand Confie's personal lines insurance distribution through credit union partnerships in Texas.
why: Confie is a major private insurance distribution firm. Acquisitions in the insurance brokerage space are common strategies to increase market share, diversify distribution channels, and achieve economies of scale.

impacts.name: Confie
impacts.why: The acquisition expands the company's operational footprint and distribution network.
